name: epoll_ctl
synopsis: int epoll_ctl(int epfd, int op, int fd, struct epoll_event *_Nullable event);
description: epoll_ctl is used to add, modify, or remove entries in the interest list of an epoll file descriptor. It performs the specified operation on the target file descriptor.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The operation to perform: EPOLL_CTL_ADD, EPOLL_CTL_MOD, or EPOLL_CTL_DEL.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: The target file descriptor to add, modify, or remove.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Pointer to the epoll_event structure, which specifies events and data; ignored for EPOLL_CTL_DEL.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: epfd or fd is not a valid file descriptor.
op was EPOLL_CTL_ADD, and the supplied file descriptor fd is already registered with this epoll instance.
epfd is not an epoll file descriptor, or fd is the same as epfd, or the requested operation op is not supported, or an invalid event type was specified with EPOLLEXCLUSIVE.
op was EPOLL_CTL_MOD and events included EPOLLEXCLUSIVE, or EPOLLEXCLUSIVE was previously applied to this epfd and fd pair.
EPOLLEXCLUSIVE was specified in event and fd refers to an epoll instance.
fd refers to an epoll instance and this EPOLL_CTL_ADD operation would result in a circular loop or nesting depth greater than 5.
op was EPOLL_CTL_MOD or EPOLL_CTL_DEL, and fd is not registered with this epoll instance.
There was insufficient memory to handle the requested operation.
The limit imposed by /proc/sys/fs/epoll/max_user_watches was encountered during EPOLL_CTL_ADD.
The target file fd does not support epoll, such as a regular file or directory.
